nodes.label: PyAudio (Microphone Audio)
nodes.rationale: PyAudio cannot be installed with plain pip on Windows; it requires pipwin or a pre-built wheel, which is why the manifest carries a dedicated install note.

nodes.label: Hachi — Agentic AI Voice Assistant
nodes.rationale: Built for local execution using Ollama, tool calling, local SQLite memory, Microsoft Edge Neural TTS, and PyWebView desktop interface. Design intent: fully autonomous voice-enabled desktop assistant with no cloud dependency for primary operations.

nodes.label: Agentic Function Calling
nodes.rationale: Automatically understands intent and triggers system tools without hardcoded keywords. The LLM decides which tool to call based on semantic understanding of user input rather than pattern matching.

nodes.label: Qwen-First Dual-Mode Engine Routing
nodes.rationale: Qwen (local via Ollama) is the primary brain handling every request. DeepSeek (cloud) escalates only when Qwen cannot produce a valid tool call or handle complex reasoning. This keeps latency low for simple commands while providing a fallback for harder tasks. Set use_deepseek:false to run fully offline.

nodes.label: SQLite Local Database Memory
nodes.rationale: Tracks past conversations, executed tasks, and dates so Hachi can recall historical activity. Chosen for zero-config local storage with no network dependency.

nodes.label: PyWebView Desktop Interface
nodes.rationale: Sleek native desktop application window hosting the HTML/JS frontend. PyWebView chosen over Electron for lighter weight and Python-native integration.

nodes.label: Tagalog and English Bilingual Voice Support
nodes.rationale: Native Tagalog (fil-PH) and English speech recognition with Microsoft Edge Neural Voices (fil-PH-AngeloNeural / en-US-AvaNeural). Design choice to support the Philippine market with bilingual interaction.
nodes.norm_label: tagalog and english bilingual voice support

nodes.label: run.bat — 1-Click Launcher
nodes.rationale: Automatically checks if Ollama is running and starts it in the background if off, launches the Hachi Desktop Application window, and frees RAM on exit by closing Ollama. Design intent: zero-friction launch for non-technical users.

nodes.label: Desktop App UI Shell
nodes.rationale: 480x860px PyWebView-hosted interface with dark theme (Space Grotesk / Inter / IBM Plex Mono fonts), radial gradient background, and 28px border-radius shell. Design rationale: mobile-app-like contained window blending into the desktop.

nodes.label: detectUserIntent() — Client-Side Intent Detection
nodes.rationale: Performs regex-based NLP on user text before sending to backend, detecting Pomodoro, Gaming, Study, and Movie intents to pre-activate mode chips and start timers. Supplements server-side agentic function calling with instant local feedback.

nodes.label: startVoiceConversation() — Main Voice Loop
nodes.rationale: Infinite loop cycling through Listen → Process+Stream+Speak phases. Uses continuous Web Speech API recognition with silence-based endpointing (1.8s pause = end of turn). Covers all three voice states: listening, thinking, speaking.

nodes.label: listenOneTurn() — STT with Language Fallback
nodes.rationale: Uses Web Speech API with cascading language fallback (fil-PH → en-PH → en-US). Continuous recognition mode with 1.8s silence timer for endpointing and 55s watchdog to prevent stuck 'Listening' state. Each language is tried in sequence if the previous yields no speech.

nodes.label: streamAndSpeakResponse() — Parallel TTS and Streaming LLM
nodes.rationale: Reads SSE stream from /api/voice_stream while concurrently playing pre-fetched Edge TTS audio chunks. Lazy-fetches audio with a cap of 3 queued clips to avoid memory pressure. Stop-word listener runs in parallel for barge-in via voice cues (Tagalog and English).
nodes.norm_label: streamandspeakresponse() — parallel tts and streaming llm

nodes.label: applyPomoSignals() — Pomodoro Signal Handler
nodes.rationale: Unified handler that parses __START_POMODORO__ / __STOP_POMODORO__ sentinel tokens from LLM responses and keyword-based fallback detection, then triggers the timer UI. Shared by both text chat and voice response paths.

nodes.label: sanitizeHtml() — XSS Sanitizer
nodes.rationale: DOM-based HTML sanitizer that allows only a safe subset of tags and attributes from LLM output. Blocks script tags, event handlers, javascript: URLs, data: URLs, and style attributes. Renders Markdown safely via marked.js then sanitizes.

nodes.label: Pomodoro Timer UI Widget
nodes.rationale: 25-minute work / 5-min short break / 15-min long break cycle. 4 session dots. Banner with pause/stop controls. Full-screen completion notification overlay with browser Notification API support.

nodes.label: Voice Conversation Overlay UI
nodes.rationale: Full-screen overlay with pulsing orb visualization (amber=speaking, cyan=listening, desaturated=thinking), live transcript display, STT method badge, mute/end/switch controls, and animated concentric rings.

nodes.label: Hey Hachi Wake Word Detection
nodes.rationale: Polls /api/wakeword_status every 600ms. On detection, shows toast notification and auto-opens voice overlay. Paused during active voice conversations to avoid concurrent microphone access.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Viewer
nodes.rationale: Interactive vis-network visualization page for the project knowledge graph. Dark-themed sidebar with search, node info inspection panel, legend with color-coded file types, checkbox filtering controls, and dimming for deselected categories.
